request  r-0000001  GET /v1/list?prefix=%2Fservices%2F&limit=500  503
error[ZC-E0515]: a swarm fetch outlived its kill, so the image was not pulled
  cause  a process of the swarm fetch was still alive after SIGKILL to its
         process group, so the image was not pulled: the store takes one writer
         at a time
  reqid  r-0000001
  fix    find the process in state D and the disk it waits on; the start is retried   ps -eo pid,stat,wchan:32,args | awk '$2 ~ /D/'
  more   zcube explain E0515
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigcube/errors/E0515.html
